title: Distinguish the counterexamples and the compiler resources
statement: A positive quantum gap alone fails: the separate qutrit projector example tends to about .972750, while the SAME tripod with no decay, A=2I+X and source Hamiltonian .75Z tends to sin^2(pi/sqrt(10)) about .702108. Separately positive legs need not share a dark state. These floating examples are not device certificates. The real half-turn F_beta=I-2|u_beta><u_beta| and the specified two-qubit sector yield real gates/CZ only with their actual couplers. Realification adds one rebit, with loop count N<=h+3c+10t before routing/preparation/readout; 120 supplied gates become 705 loops in a diagnostic. This does not freely encode an unknown complex input: complex controls or a phase reference still cost resources.

requires: Tripod ground levels 0,1,a and excited e; shared A_E on all legs with gI<=Re A_E<=hI, g>0, decay kappa>0 and bounded differential excited Hamiltonian.

Loaded logical dark code, arbitrary source/reference correlations and actual code-restricted channel; the common source Hamiltonian can be removed mathematically without an available physical inverse.

Coherently retaining the entire radiation field is outside the gate bound. Real optical global-domain operation, microscopic entangling couplers, practical advantage and priority remain open. Source-bound claims and actual supplied review scope only. No Capital scientific reproof,code replay,correctness/novelty investigation,new sign-off,producer contact or transfer recovery. costs: Physical ramp, preparation, restoration/reset, readout and inactive-carrier spectator protection are paid.
Compiler routing, elementary controls, precision, real source-domain qualification and all failed trials remain costs; sufficient upper bounds are not optimal lower bounds.
